questions.q: How much of their income do many low-income renters spend on housing?
a: Half, and one in four pays seventy percent or more
A third, with very few paying more

questions.q: Why have evictions become common in the United States?

Landlords stopped maintaining their buildings
Courts began processing cases much faster
Tenants simply stopped paying by choice
questions.why: Lesson 1 blames rising rent, falling pay and lost manufacturing jobs.
